98@triton.jit 

99def _ccol_copy_strided_nd_kernel( 

100 src_ptr, dst_ptr, n_elem, meta_ptr, ndim: tl.constexpr, BLOCK: tl.constexpr 

101): 

102 # meta layout: for dim i in [0, ndim): meta[2*i] = size[i], meta[2*i+1] = stride[i] 

103 # (one int64 device tensor built host-side and uploaded in a single copy) 

104 pid = tl.program_id(0) 

105 offs = pid * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK) 

106 mask = offs < n_elem 

107 idx = offs 

108 in_off = tl.zeros([BLOCK], dtype=tl.int64) 

109 for k in tl.static_range(ndim): 

110 i = ndim - 1 - k 

111 d = tl.load(meta_ptr + 2 * i).to(tl.int64) 

112 s = tl.load(meta_ptr + 2 * i + 1).to(tl.int64) 

113 c = idx % d 

114 idx = idx // d 

115 in_off += c * s 

116 v = tl.load(src_ptr + in_off, mask=mask) 

117 tl.store(dst_ptr + offs, v, mask=mask)

120def _cached_meta(src: torch.Tensor, shape, strides) -> torch.Tensor: 

121 """Return the (size, stride) metadata buffer for the ND-strided kernel.

123 Reused across calls with the same geometry, so a repeat launch neither 

124 allocates nor uploads it again.

127 meta = _META_CACHE.get(key) 

128 if meta is None: 

129 meta = torch.tensor(

132 device=src.device, 

133 ) 

134 if len(_META_CACHE) >= _META_CACHE_MAX: 

135 _META_CACHE.clear() 

136 _META_CACHE[key] = meta 

137 return meta

143 ``needs_device_guard`` records whether the input lived on a device that was

154 compiled.run, 

155 compiled.function, 

156 compiled.packed_metadata,

161def _launch(kernel, grid_x: int, src, dst, scalars: tuple, block: int, device) -> None: 

162 """Launch ``kernel`` through its cached ``CompiledKernel`` handle. 

163 

164 The cache key carries every fact Triton specialises a kernel on — the 

165 kernel, the grid, the ``BLOCK`` constexpr, the device and, per argument, the 

166 dtype plus the 16-byte alignment of pointers or the exact scalar value — so 

167 a cache hit is a kernel compiled for exactly these arguments and never a 

168 handle that assumes a different alignment or a different scalar constant. 

169 

170 The launcher receives raw ``data_ptr`` addresses: the pointer conversion is 

171 already needed for the cache key, and the ints are ~1.3us cheaper per launch 

172 than the tensor objects (whose references the caller keeps alive for the 

173 duration of the launch). 

174 """ 

175 src_ptr = src.data_ptr() 

176 dst_ptr = dst.data_ptr() 

177 device_index = device.index 

178 key = ( 

179 kernel, 

180 grid_x, 

181 block, 

182 device_index, 

183 src.dtype, 

184 src_ptr & 15, 

185 dst.dtype, 

186 dst_ptr & 15, 

187 *scalars, 

188 ) 

189 entry = _LAUNCH_CACHE.get(key) 

190 if entry is None: 

191 entry = _build_launch(kernel, grid_x, (src, dst) + scalars, block, device)

193 _LAUNCH_CACHE.clear()

196 stream = _get_current_stream(device_index).native_handle 

197 if needs_device_guard: 

198 with torch_device_fn.device(device): 

199 run( 

200 grid_x, 

201 1, 

202 1, 

203 stream, 

204 function, 

205 packed_metadata, 

206 None, 

207 None, 

208 None, 

209 src_ptr, 

210 dst_ptr, 

211 *scalars, 

212 block, 

213 ) 

214 else: 

215 run( 

216 grid_x, 

217 1, 

218 1, 

219 stream, 

220 function, 

221 packed_metadata, 

222 None, 

223 None, 

224 None, 

225 src_ptr, 

226 dst_ptr,

232def _select_src(self: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor: 

233 """Layout dispatch shared by both overloads. 

234 

235 Returns the ``ccol_indices()`` metadata view for CSC/BSC inputs, raises the 

236 native rejection message for the other compressed/strided layouts, and 

237 delegates to the native operator for anything else. 

238 

239 For CSC/BSC inputs built through the wrapped sparse constructors the view is 

240 taken straight from the backend component cache; every other case goes 

241 through ``self.ccol_indices()``. 

242 

243 The explicit guard is required by the native contract, not optional 

244 defensive code: once this implementation is registered on the backend 

245 dispatch keys (the general registrar always binds the plain device key as 

246 well), re-dispatching a strided/CSR/BSR input re-enters this override 

247 instead of reaching the native layout check, so the rejection has to be 

248 produced here. COO inputs are deliberately NOT guarded: they dispatch on 

249 the ``SparseCUDA`` key, which native never registered a kernel for, so the 

250 delegation reaches the dispatcher's own ``NotImplementedError`` — the 

251 exact native behaviour (verified: strided/CSR/BSR raise RuntimeError, COO 

252 raises NotImplementedError on this build). 

253 """ 

254 layout = self.layout 

255 if layout is _L_CSC or layout is _L_BSC: 

256 if _SPARSE_COMPONENTS is not None: 

257 entry = _SPARSE_COMPONENTS.get(id(self)) 

258 if entry is not None: 

259 # entry = [sparse, compressed(ccol), plain(row), values]. 

260 # Read-only view for the copy kernels; no detach needed here. 

261 return entry[1] 

262 return self.ccol_indices() 

263 layout_name = _NON_COL_COMPRESSED_LAYOUT_NAMES.get(layout) 

264 if layout_name is not None: 

265 raise RuntimeError( 

266 "ccol_indices expected sparse column compressed tensor layout " 

267 f"but got {layout_name}" 

268 ) 

269 # COO and any other layout: native has no kernel for them (verified on 

270 # H20: CUDA COO raises ``NotImplementedError`` with the message below), 

271 # so the rejection is reproduced explicitly instead of redispatching to 

272 # the same operator from the host implementation. 

273 backend = _SPARSE_BACKEND_NAME.get(self.device.type, "Sparse") 

274 raise NotImplementedError( 

275 "Could not run 'aten::ccol_indices_copy' with arguments from the " 

276 f"'{backend}' backend. This could be because the operator doesn't " 

277 "exist for that backend." 

278 )

281def _launch_ccol_copy(src: torch.Tensor, dst: torch.Tensor) -> None: 

282 """Copy the ``src`` ccol view into ``dst`` with the three kernels below. 

283 

284 Contiguous sources take the flat kernel; a non-contiguous 1-D source takes 

285 the single-stride gather kernel; a non-contiguous multi-dim (batched) 

286 source takes the ND-strided gather kernel, which reads through per-dim 

287 size/stride metadata uploaded in one H2D copy. Empty tensors skip the 

288 launch entirely (the grid would be ``(0,)``), mirroring the source's 

289 ``if n:`` guard. 

290 """ 

291 n = src.numel() 

292 if n == 0: 

293 return 

294 grid_x = (n + _BLOCK - 1) // _BLOCK 

295 device = src.device 

296 if src.is_contiguous(): 

297 _launch(_ccol_copy_kernel, grid_x, src, dst, (n,), _BLOCK, device) 

298 elif src.dim() == 1: 

299 _launch( 

300 _ccol_copy_strided_kernel, 

301 grid_x, 

302 src, 

303 dst, 

304 (n, src.stride(0)), 

305 _BLOCK, 

306 device, 

307 ) 

308 else: 

309 # Multi-dim non-contiguous ccol buffer: gather through per-dim 

310 # size/stride metadata (built host-side, uploaded in one H2D copy). 

311 # Native ATen handles these inputs, so the branch is part of the 

312 # contract (review: this closes the previously disclosed divergence). 

313 shape = src.shape 

314 strides = src.stride() 

315 meta = _cached_meta(src, shape, strides) 

316 with torch_device_fn.device(device): 

317 _ccol_copy_strided_nd_kernel[(grid_x,)]( 

318 src, 

319 dst, 

320 n, 

321 meta, 

322 ndim=len(shape), 

323 BLOCK=_BLOCK, 

324 num_warps=_NUM_WARPS, 

325 )

328def ccol_indices_copy(self: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor: 

329 """Return a fresh contiguous copy of a CSC/BSC tensor's compressed columns. 

330 

331 Mirrors ``aten::ccol_indices_copy(Tensor self) -> Tensor``: the result is a 

332 newly allocated, contiguous, independent int64 tensor holding the input's 

333 compressed-column-index array (``batch_dims + (ncols + 1,)`` for CSC, 

334 ``batch_dims + (n_col_blocks + 1,)`` for BSC). The input is never mutated 

335 and the result never aliases the input's internal ccol storage (fresh 

336 ``data_ptr``, ``_base is None``); verified against native ATen on H20. 

337 

338 Only column-compressed layouts are accepted. Strided/CSR/BSR inputs are 

339 rejected with the native ``RuntimeError`` ("ccol_indices expected sparse 

340 column compressed tensor layout but got <Layout>"); COO falls through to 

341 the dispatcher's native ``NotImplementedError`` (native has no kernel for 

342 the Sparse key). The guard raises the RuntimeError itself because a 

343 re-dispatch of a strided/CSR/BSR input re-enters this override once 

344 registered on the backend dispatch keys (the registrar always binds the 

345 plain device key as well), so the native check is unreachable for them. 

346 

347 The data movement is performed by the three Triton kernels below, selected 

348 by the source layout: a flat copy for a contiguous source, a single-stride 

349 gather for a non-contiguous 1-D source, and an ND-strided gather for a 

350 non-contiguous multi-dim (batched) source, which reads through per-dim 

351 size/stride metadata uploaded in one H2D copy. All three cases match native 

352 ATen; there is no disclosed divergence. The batched strided path is covered 

353 by ``test_accuracy_ccol_indices_copy_strided_ccol_multi_dim``. 

354 

355 Tensors built through the public sparse constructors always expose a 

356 contiguous ccol array, so the two gather branches serve hand-built 

357 metadata; native accepts those inputs, so they are implemented rather than 

358 rejected. 

359 """ 

360 logger.debug("GEMS_ENFLAME CCOL_INDICES_COPY") 

361 src = _select_src(self) 

362 out = torch.empty_like(src) 

363 _launch_ccol_copy(src, out) 

364 return out

367def ccol_indices_copy_out(self: torch.Tensor, *, out: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor: 

368 """Variant of :func:`ccol_indices_copy` that writes into ``out``. 

369 

370 Mirrors ``aten::ccol_indices_copy.out``: the ``out`` tensor must carry the 

371 ccol dtype (int64 for default-index tensors, int32 for int32 index 

372 tensors), is resized to ``batch_dims + (ncols + 1,)`` when its shape 

373 differs, receives the ccol values through the same Triton kernels, and is 

374 returned itself (native aliasing contract: the returned tensor IS the 

375 ``out`` argument). A non-contiguous ``out`` is written through a contiguous 

376 staging buffer, matching the native behaviour of writing element-wise 

377 through the out strides. 

378 """ 

379 logger.debug("GEMS_ENFLAME CCOL_INDICES_COPY_OUT") 

380 src = _select_src(self) 

381 if out.dtype != src.dtype: 

382 raise RuntimeError( 

383 f"Expected out tensor to have dtype {src.dtype}, but got {out.dtype} instead" 

384 ) 

385 if out.device != src.device: 

386 # Native rejects a cross-device out before launching the kernel 

387 # (verified on H20: CUDA sparse + CPU out raises this exact message); 

388 # without the guard the Triton launch would receive pointers from 

389 # different devices instead of raising. 

390 raise RuntimeError( 

391 f"Expected out tensor to have device {src.device}, but got " 

392 f"{out.device} instead" 

393 ) 

394 if tuple(out.shape) != tuple(src.shape): 

395 out.resize_(src.shape) 

396 dst = out if out.is_contiguous() else out.contiguous() 

397 _launch_ccol_copy(src, dst) 

398 if dst.data_ptr() != out.data_ptr(): 

399 out.copy_(dst) 

400 return out
